items.title: Stocks in news: Maruti Suzuki, ITC, ZEE, Persistent Systems, and Muthoot Finance
items.description: Markets extended their winning streak on Friday, supported by encouraging quarterly business updates. Nifty strengthened its bullish structure by surpassing the 200-day EMA, positioning for further gains. ITC reported a net profit drop while revenue rose, and Maruti Suzuki saw a net profit decline. Sun Pharma reported net profit growth, and PNB has no immediate plans to monetize subsidiaries.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Domestic markets extended their winning streak for a third consecutive session. Nifty advanced nearly two percent last week, driven by strong quarterly earnings. Analysts expect Indian equities to trade with a positive bias this week. Investors will monitor the RBI's monetary policy decision and PMI data. Crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions in West Asia remain key watchpoints.

items.title: AI trade unwind, FII inflows brighten August outlook for Indian stocks
items.description: Indian equities are expected to extend recent gains in August, supported by foreign fund inflows. Analysts anticipate a continued upward move for the Nifty after recent consolidation periods. Foreign institutional investors have turned positive, marking their first net purchases since February. While geopolitical uncertainties remain, the unwinding of AI trade is seen as positive. Select large caps and specific sectors like NBFCs, pharma, metals, and realty may perform well.

items.title: New F&O closing auction rules: Impact on traders, investors decoded
items.description: Exchanges will change how stock closing prices are decided for F&O stocks. A new closing auction will determine the final price after normal trading ends. This auction aims to reduce the impact of last-minute large orders. Mutual funds will benefit from more efficient execution of their closing trades. Active traders and proprietary desks will see the biggest impact from these changes.

items.title: RBI likely to extend rate pause; neutral stance seen unchanged
items.description: Economists anticipate the Reserve Bank of India will maintain its current interest rate at 5.25 percent. The central bank is also expected to keep its neutral monetary policy stance for the fourth review. Some economists foresee a potential rate hike in the second half of fiscal year twenty twenty-seven. Inflation forecasts for fiscal year twenty twenty-seven are divided among surveyed economists.

items.title: Stock Radar: Amara Raja Energy on verge of a breakout from ascending triangle formation. Time to buy?
items.description: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility is nearing a breakout from an ascending triangle pattern after months of consolidation, with analysts seeing upside towards Rs 990-995 over the next 5-7 weeks. A decisive move above Rs 920 could confirm the bullish setup, while Rs 860 remains the key stop-loss level.

items.title: RBI special windows seen big enough to bring in $100B
items.description: India's new forex inflow programs may attract approximately one hundred billion dollars.  These special drives have already mobilized over forty billion dollars in foreign exchange.  Experts predict these initiatives could significantly exceed initial mobilization estimates.  The Reserve Bank of India introduced these facilities to support the balance of payments.  These programs aim to cushion the rupee and contain imported inflation.

items.title: Banks propose 'Yes-No' prompt for high-risk UPI transfers to curb digital payment frauds
items.description: Indian banks are proposing payment app prompts to curb rising digital frauds.  This aims to balance fraud prevention with maintaining digital payment convenience.  Banks suggest prompts for suspicious transactions, not all payments above a threshold.  The Reserve Bank of India is considering these suggestions for new guidelines.  This initiative seeks to protect users while preserving digital payment growth.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki shares decline over 2% after Q1. Morgan Stanley, Motilal Oswal decode the road ahead
items.description: Maruti Suzuki shares fell over 2% after the automaker reported an 11% YoY decline in June-quarter standalone net profit, even as revenue rose 36% and sales volumes hit a record high. While Nomura retained a Neutral rating citing margin risks, Motilal Oswal reiterated its Buy call, expecting market share gains, easing input costs and strong earnings growth to support the stock.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Morgan Stanley maintains buy on Maruti Suzuki; Citi retains buy on Sun Pharma
items.description: Global brokerages remained selective on large-cap stocks following the latest round of quarterly earnings, with Citi reiterating its bullish view on Sun Pharma and Morgan Stanley backing Maruti Suzuki despite trimming estimates. Meanwhile, Motilal Oswal maintained a cautious stance on ITC amid continued pressure on its cigarette business.

items.title: High dividend yield stocks: Vedanta, Coal India among 15 largecap stocks with high dividend yields. Do you own any?
items.description: While the Indian stock market sees sharp upswings and downswings amid the seesaw political game in the Middle East, elevated crude prices, and global AI trade, investors keep cashing in dividends announced by companies. Domestic brokerage firm Axis Direct’ latest report highlighted top dividend yield stocks, which lists companies that have consistently rewarded shareholders with strong payouts. A dividend yield is a financial ratio that shows how much a company pays out in dividends each year relative to its stock price. Here are 15 large cap stocks with the highest dividend yields, according to the report.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex surges 500 points, Nifty above 24,500. 6 key factors fueling the rally
items.description: Indian stock markets saw significant gains on Monday, with the Sensex and Nifty rising approximately one percent. This surge followed US President Donald Trump's announcement of upcoming talks with Iran, which lowered oil prices. Major companies like IndiGo and ITC experienced substantial increases, contributing to the market's upward movement. Sectors such as FMCG and Metal also demonstrated strong performance, reflecting positive investor sentiment.

items.title: Urban Company shares zoom 15% after Q1 results. Why Motilal Oswal raised target price
items.description: Urban Company reported a Rs 92 crore net loss in Q1 FY27 despite a 44% YoY rise in revenue to Rs 528 crore, mainly due to losses from its InstaHelp business. Motilal Oswal retained its ‘Neutral’ rating but raised the target price to Rs 140, implying over 8% upside.

items.title: ITC shares gain 3% after Q1 results. Here’s why Nomura upgraded the stock to Buy
items.description: ITC shares rose 2% after the FMCG major reported June-quarter results, despite a 27% YoY decline in standalone net profit. Revenue grew 28%, while Nomura upgraded the stock to Buy, citing an attractive risk-reward profile and potential recovery in cigarette profitability. ITC also warned that imported inflation, a weak monsoon, lower kharif sowing and West Asia tensions could pose near-term risks.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv shares rise over 2% after Q1 earnings. Here's why Motilal Oswal upgrades to Buy, raises target price
items.description: Bajaj Finserv shares climbed after reporting a 12% net profit increase for Q1 FY27. Revenue from operations grew nineteen percent year-on-year, and interest income also saw gains. Bajaj Finance's customer base expanded significantly, and new loans booked showed substantial growth. Insurance businesses reported premium increases and strong new business value growth. Brokerages upgraded their ratings and raised target prices following the company's performance.

items.title: Advance Technoforge shares to list on BSE SME today; GMP indicates mild listing gains
items.description: Advance Technoforge shares are set to debut on the BSE SME platform on August 3, with a 4% grey market premium indicating a potential listing price of around Rs 99 against the issue price of Rs 95. The IPO was subscribed 1.55 times overall.

items.title: Propshop Events & Exhibitions shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Propshop Events & Exhibitions Ltd. debuts on the NSE SME platform on Monday. The company's shares show no grey market premium ahead of listing. Its initial public offering received a moderate response from investors. The IPO raised Rs 28.57 crore for growth and working capital. The IPO proceeds will strengthen operations and support business expansion initiatives.

items.title: Nifty trapped in 1,531-point range for 15 weeks. Can global AI unwind bring FIIs back?
items.description: The Nifty index is approaching a critical juncture after a prolonged consolidation period. Foreign institutional investors are showing early signs of returning after significant outflows this year. The unwinding of global artificial intelligence trades may encourage capital reallocation into India. Recent market gains were supported by strong domestic institutional buying and easing inflation concerns. Technical indicators suggest a potential breakout if the index sustains above key resistance levels.

items.title: Thermax among 5 stocks closed above VWAP, signaling bullish shift
items.description: On July 31, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied more than 2% above their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A move above the VWAP indicates that the closing price was higher than the average price at which the stock traded during the session, weighted by trading volume.This is widely interpreted by traders and investors as a bullish signal, suggesting stronger buying interest and positive market sentiment.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On July 31, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward price momentum.

items.title: Jaiprakash Power Ventures among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 31, five stocks in the Nifty500 pack that gained over 5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels.“RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Stock market closing time changes from today: What happens at 3:15, 3:30 and 3:40 PM
items.description: India's stock market introduces new closing times and auction sessions starting today.  Continuous trading for F&O stocks ends at 3:15 p.m. for a new auction process.  Other stocks will continue trading until 3:30 p.m. while derivatives trade until 3:40 p.m.  This new system aims to improve price discovery and reduce market impact.  The closing price will now be determined by an equilibrium price during the auction.
